_comment: 2D box, 2 groups with upscatter into group 0 (so the whole problem is the thermal block: no group is solved only once), all faces reflective with absorption in every group: the exact discrete solution is the per-group constant of the 2x2 infinite-medium group system, checked by -check_inf_medium. cg_box_up2_inf_medium.json is its CG-SUPG twin.
